_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored, in this same directory) and fill it in.
It must live BESIDE manifest.json: that is the only directory the add-on can
read with chrome.runtime.getURL, and amo_publish.py / cws_publish.py default
to the same file so every half stays in step.
Two layers on purpose: keep the interesting half — items, path templates,
the locale table — in a file your PROJECT commits, and point at it with
"extends" (absolute path; the add-on has no path of its own to resolve a
relative one against). This file then holds only what must never be
committed: credentials, and assets.root. Anything declared here wins.
You can also drop "extends" and put everything here — see examples/ for
Pick ONE mode. serviceAccountKey is preferred: a refresh token
expires every 7 days while the OAuth consent screen is in
cryptography` (RS256 is not in the standard library).
